by
  have h1 : (a / b + b / c + c / a) ≥ 3 :=
    let a_b := a / b
    let b_c := b / c
    let c_a := c / a
    let sum := a_b + b_c + c_a
    let prod := a_b * b_c * c_a
    have h2 : prod = 1 :=
      by simp [a_b, b_c, c_a, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_one]
    have h3 : a_b ≥ 1 :=
      by apply real.ge_one_of_pos; exact ha.trans (real.inv_pos (hb.trans hc))
    have h4 : b_c ≥ 1 :=
      by apply real.ge_one_of_pos; exact hb.trans (real.inv_pos (hc.trans ha))
    have h5 : c_a ≥ 1 :=
      by apply real.ge_one_of_pos; exact hc.trans (real.inv_pos (ha.trans hb))
    have h6 : sum ≥ 3 :=
      by apply real.ge_three_of_ge_one_and_ge_one_and_ge_one; exact ⟨h3, h4, h5⟩
  exact h1
